name: WF 5 - Travelistguide — KIE.AI Stories Machine (IG + FB) for Postiz

parameters.content:
## WF 5 — STORIES MACHINE (IG + FB)
Generates multi-frame 9:16 stories → KIE.AI images → Google Sheet (Status = Pending) → approve → publish with Postiz.

**Sheet tabs needed (same spreadsheet):**
- `Stories pending`
- `Stories rejected`
Paste the header row from the README into row 1 of both tabs.

## PHASE 1 — STORY RESEARCH
Schedule → Config → Read existing stories → KIE Chat → Parse ideas + duplicate check.

## PHASE 2 — STORY SCORE
Score 0–100 for story performance (completion, replies, sticker taps). LOW → Stories rejected.

## PHASE 3 — STORY SCRIPT
Frame-by-frame: on-screen text, sticker idea, CTA, 9:16 image prompt. Split into 1 item per frame.

## PHASE 4 — KIE.AI 9:16 IMAGES
Create task → wait → fetch → extract URL (one image per frame).
Model: nano-banana-2-lite, aspect 9:16

## PHASE 5 — APPROVAL → POSTIZ
One row per frame, Status = Pending. Set Status = Approved, then your Postiz publisher posts each frame as a story (post type = story), in Frame_Number order.

assignments.value: Wellness destinations, Nature escapes, Quick travel tips, Yoga & spa moments, Mindfulness prompts, Slow travel, Digital detox, Healthy travel habits, Retreat teasers, This-or-that polls, Packing checklists, Myth vs fact

const cfg = $('Merge Config + Existing').first().json;

const sys = 'You are a senior Instagram & Facebook Stories strategist for a wellness-travel brand. Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown fences, no explanation.';

const user = [
  'Propose ' + cfg.stories_per_run + ' fresh STORY ideas for ' + cfg.platforms + ' for the brand ' + cfg.brand_name + ' (' + cfg.niche + ').',
  'A story idea = a short sequence of ' + cfg.frames_per_story + ' vertical 9:16 frames viewed in ~15 seconds each.',
  '',
  'STORY PILLARS:',
  cfg.story_pillars,
  '',
  'ALREADY USED STORY TOPICS (never repeat, never propose close variations):',
  cfg.existing_topic_block,
  '',
  'GOOD STORY FORMATS: Poll, Quiz, This-or-That, Question box, Quick tips, Checklist, Myth vs Fact, Destination teaser, Countdown, Behind-the-scenes, Mini-guide, Mood board.',
  '',
  'HARD RULES:',
  '- Ideas must work in a fast, tap-through, mobile-first format (very little text).',
  '- At least one idea must be interactive (poll / quiz / question / slider).',
  '- Never invent statistics, prices or follower counts. Any number must be labelled "(AI estimate)".',
  '- Write in ' + cfg.language + ' only.',
  '- Return ONLY valid JSON.',
  '',
  'Return this exact shape:',
  '{"stories":[{"topic":"","story_format":"Poll|Quiz|This-or-That|Question box|Quick tips|Checklist|Myth vs Fact|Destination teaser|Countdown|Behind-the-scenes|Mini-guide|Mood board","primary_keyword":"","secondary_keywords":["",""],"goal":"Engagement|Reach|Profile visits|Link clicks","why_now":"","data_note":"AI estimate - no live data used"}]}'
].join('\n');

return [{ json: { model: 'deepseek-v4-1-flash', stream: false, instructions: sys, input: [{ role: 'user', content: user }] } }];

const src = $json;
const cfg = $('Config').first().json;
const n = Number(cfg.frames_per_story) || 4;

const sys = 'You are a senior Stories copywriter and art director for ' + cfg.brand_name + ', a wellness travel brand. Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown fences.';

const user = [
  'Write a ' + n + '-frame vertical STORY sequence for ' + cfg.platforms + '. Organic brand awareness, NOT a sales pitch.',
  '',
  'TOPIC: ' + src.topic,
  'FORMAT: ' + src.story_format,
  'GOAL: ' + src.goal,
  'KEYWORDS: ' + src.keywords,
  'SCORE: ' + src.story_score + '/100 (' + src.opportunity + ')',
  'TARGET AUDIENCE: ' + src.target_audience,
  'SUGGESTED STICKER: ' + src.best_sticker,
  'LINK FOR LAST FRAME: ' + (cfg.link_url || 'none'),
  '',
  'FRAME RULES:',
  '- Exactly ' + n + ' frames.',
  '- Frame 1 = HOOK: max 8 words on screen, creates curiosity, makes people stay.',
  '- Middle frames = VALUE: one idea per frame, max 15 words on screen.',
  '- Include exactly ONE interactive frame (poll / quiz / question / slider) with the exact sticker text and options.',
  '- Last frame = soft CTA (send to a friend, reply, visit link, follow for more). NEVER "buy now".',
  '- Sound human, warm and calm, never like an AI. Max 1 emoji per frame.',
  '- Never invent statistics, prices, opening hours or fake facts.',
  '- image_prompt: one photorealistic VERTICAL 9:16 wellness-travel scene per frame, same visual mood across all frames, subject in the lower two-thirds, calm uncluttered upper third. Do NOT describe any text in the image_prompt, no logos.',
  '- alt_text: one plain sentence describing the image for accessibility.',
  '- caption: optional 1-2 short lines (used by Facebook / Postiz as post text), 3-5 hashtags max.',
  '',
  'Return ONLY valid JSON:',
  '{"story_angle":"","frames":[{"frame":1,"role":"Hook|Value|Interaction|CTA","on_screen_text":"","sticker_type":"none|poll|quiz|question|slider|link|countdown","sticker_content":"","image_prompt":"","alt_text":""}],"music_mood":"","caption":"","hashtags":["#tag"]}'
].join('\n');

return { json: { model: 'deepseek-v4-1-flash', stream: false, instructions: sys, input: [{ role: 'user', content: user }] } };
